title: Fictional lumbar MRI prior authorization rule
text: In order: inactive plan -> Deny; explicitly established back pain under 6 weeks or physiotherapy under 6 weeks -> Deny; missing pain or physiotherapy duration -> Need more information; otherwise -> Approve. Exactly 6 weeks qualifies. No physiotherapy tried means 0 weeks; unmentioned physiotherapy or physiotherapy mentioned without duration means null. Other treatment is not physiotherapy.
